producer: Revision/theory/python/check_field_theory.py (sympy, exact; own jet super-algebra superalg.py for both statistics)
spec: Revision/SPEC.md sections 1-6 (metric, Clifford data, the two fields, EMT, quantisation)
independence: no code shared with Revision/theory/wolfram; the Wolfram outputs are read only by the final comparison section

checks.name: superalgebra_axioms
checks.section: 0. the jet super-algebra (own implementation)
checks.detail: psi psi = 0 and psi_A psi_B = -psi_B psi_A (Grassmann), commuting products symmetric with nonzero squares; (chi_A psi_B)^* = chi_B psi_A (order reversal), (i chi psi)^* = -i chi psi for A = B; left/right derivatives with the Grassmann signs; total derivative acts on the jet coordinates

checks.name: sqrt_det_g_equals_cos_z
checks.section: B. vielbein, Christoffel symbols, canonical spin connection (author's metric)
checks.detail: sqrt|det g| = product of the f_a = c (ring) = cos(6 H x8)

checks.name: christoffel_symmetric_metric_compatible
checks.section: B. vielbein, Christoffel symbols, canonical spin connection (author's metric)
checks.detail: Gamma^l_ab = Gamma^l_ba and nabla_mu g_ab = 0; 25 independent nonzero symbols

checks.name: spin_connection_antisymmetric

checks.name: vielbein_postulate
checks.section: B. vielbein, Christoffel symbols, canonical spin connection (author's metric)
checks.detail: d_mu e^a_nu - Gamma^l_mu nu e^a_l + omega_mu^a_b e^b_nu = 0 for all mu, a, nu (512 components)

checks.name: Omega_x4_and_Omega_x8_vanish
checks.section: B. vielbein, Christoffel symbols, canonical spin connection (author's metric)
checks.detail: Omega_(x4) = Omega_(x8) = 0 identically (the diagonal vielbein makes omega_mu ab nonzero only for mu in {a, b} with the other index x4 or x8); Omega_(xi) = (exp(a4(x4))*sin(6*H*x8)**(1/6)*Derivative(a4(x4), x4))*S^(x1,x4) + (H*exp(a4(x4))*sin(6*H*x8)**(1/6))*S^(x1,x8) for i = 1,2,3; Omega_(x5,x6,x7) analogous: (-exp(-a4(x4))*sin(6*H*x8)**(1/6)*Derivative(a4(x4), x4))*S^(x4,x5) + (-H*exp(-a4(x4))*sin(6*H*x8)**(1/6))*S^(x5,x8)

checks.name: covariant_constancy_D_mu_gamma_nu
checks.section: B. vielbein, Christoffel symbols, canonical spin connection (author's metric)
checks.detail: D_mu gamma^nu = d_mu gamma^nu + Gamma^nu_mu l gamma^l + [Omega_mu, gamma^nu] = 0 for all 64 (mu, nu)

checks.name: gamma_mu_Omega_mu_equals_3H_gamma_x8
checks.section: B. vielbein, Christoffel symbols, canonical spin connection (author's metric)
checks.detail: gamma^mu Omega_mu = 3 H gamma^(x8) exactly (independent of a4 and of x4, x8)

checks.name: time_terms_cancel_hidden_term_survives
checks.section: B. vielbein, Christoffel symbols, canonical spin connection (author's metric)
checks.detail: per direction gamma^(xi) Omega_(xi) = (1/2) a4' gamma^(x4) + (H/2) gamma^(x8) for the inflating i = 1,2,3 and = -(1/2) a4' gamma^(x4) + (H/2) gamma^(x8) for the deflating extra times i = 5,6,7; the x4 terms cancel (inflating sum 3*A1/2, deflating sum -3*A1/2); the six hidden-direction terms add to 3*H gamma^(x8)

checks.name: anticommutator_gamma_Omega_vanishes
checks.section: B. vielbein, Christoffel symbols, canonical spin connection (author's metric)
checks.detail: sum_mu {gamma^mu, Omega_mu} = 0: only the totally antisymmetric part of omega enters the symmetric Lagrangian and it vanishes for this diagonal vielbein; gravity enters L through e^mu_a and sqrt|g|, and the field equation through gamma^mu Omega_mu = 3 H gamma^(x8) = (1/2)(1/sqrt|g|) d_mu(sqrt|g| e^mu_a) gamma^a

checks.name: divergence_of_sqrtg_gamma
checks.section: B. vielbein, Christoffel symbols, canonical spin connection (author's metric)
checks.detail: (1/2)(1/sqrt|g|) d_mu(sqrt|g| gamma^mu) = 3 H gamma^(x8) = gamma^mu Omega_mu

checks.name: nontriviality_Omega_zero_iff_flat
checks.section: B. vielbein, Christoffel symbols, canonical spin connection (author's metric)
checks.detail: Omega_(x1) = (A1*E*s) S^(x1,x4) + (E*H*s) S^(x1,x8), Omega_(x5) = (-A1*s/E) S^(x4,x5) + (-H*s/E) S^(x5,x8): the S^ab are linearly independent and E = e^a4 > 0, s > 0 on 0 < z < pi/2, so every Omega_mu vanishes iff a4' = 0 AND H = 0 (formal flat limit with s, c frozen; at H = 0 the metric itself degenerates since sin(6 H x8) = 0, so within the author's family the spin connection never vanishes); the field-equation term gamma^mu Omega_mu = 3 H gamma^(x8) is nonzero for every H > 0

checks.name: curvature_nonzero_flat_only_formally
checks.section: C. curvature, integrability (Lichnerowicz)
checks.detail: Ricci scalar R = 6*(A1**2 - 7*H**2) (ring); for a4 = const R = -42*H**2 which is nonzero for H > 0: the metric is curved for every member of the family; every Riemann component vanishes only in the formal limit a4' = a4'' = 0, H = 0 (flat 4+4)

checks.name: spinor_curvature_equals_riemann
checks.section: C. curvature, integrability (Lichnerowicz)
checks.detail: [D_mu, D_nu] = F_mu nu = d_mu Omega_nu - d_nu Omega_mu + [Omega_mu, Omega_nu] = (1/4) R_{rho sigma mu nu} gamma^rho gamma^sigma for all mu != nu (integrability of the spin connection; R^rho_{sigma mu nu} = d_mu Gamma^rho_{nu sigma} - ...)

checks.name: lichnerowicz_contraction
checks.section: C. curvature, integrability (Lichnerowicz)
checks.detail: gamma^mu gamma^nu F_mu nu = -(R/2) I16 exactly

checks.name: lichnerowicz_identity_on_fields
checks.section: C. curvature, integrability (Lichnerowicz)
checks.detail: (gamma^mu D_mu)^2 Psi = g^{mu nu} nabla_mu D_nu Psi - (R/4) Psi identically on the jet space: the first-order operator squares to the second-order one with the curvature term -R/4, R = 6(a4'^2 - 7 H^2) (integrability of the Dirac-type equation in this metric)

checks.name: canonical_momentum
checks.section: H. canonical quantisation in 4+4 (dirac16complex)
checks.detail: pi_A = dL/d(d_4 Psi_A) (right derivative) = i sqrt|g| (Psi^dagger B)_A for the first-order form sqrt|g|[Psibar gamma^mu D_mu Psi - ...] (and one half of it for the symmetric L, which differs by a total divergence; second-class constraints give the same bracket); B = -i C gamma^(x4), gamma^(x4) = gamma^(4)

checks.name: canonical_anticommutator_B
checks.section: H. canonical quantisation in 4+4 (dirac16complex)
checks.detail: {Psi_A(x), pi_B(y)} = i delta_AB delta^7(x-y) with pi = i sqrt|g| Psi^dagger B forces {Psi_A(x), Psi^dagger_C(y)} = X_AC delta^7(x-y)/sqrt|g| with X B = 1, unique solution X = B^{-1} = B

checks.name: no_positive_inner_product
checks.section: H. canonical quantisation in 4+4 (dirac16complex)
checks.detail: B has an 8-dimensional eigenspace for -1; for a unit vector u in it, Q = u^dagger Psi satisfies {Q, Q^dagger} = u^dagger B u / sqrt|g| = -1/sqrt|g| < 0, while in any positive-definite Hilbert space {Q, Q^dagger} = Q Q^dagger + Q^dagger Q is positive semidefinite: the state space must carry an indefinite (Krein) inner product

checks.name: mode_hamiltonian_B_selfadjoint_dispersion
checks.section: H. canonical quantisation in 4+4 (dirac16complex)
checks.detail: plane waves u e^{i(k.x - E x4)} (frame momenta k_a): E u = h u, h = -i m gamma^(4) - sum_{a != x4} k_a gamma^(4) gamma^(a); B h = h^dagger B (h is B-self-adjoint) and h^2 = (m^2 + k1^2 + k2^2 + k3^2 + k8^2 - k5^2 - k6^2 - k7^2) I16

checks.name: good_sector_spectrum_and_B_sectors
checks.section: H. canonical quantisation in 4+4 (dirac16complex)
checks.detail: good sector (k5 = k6 = k7 = 0, no extra-time momentum, frame level): h is Hermitian on the full 16-dim space with energies +-sqrt(m^2 + k1^2 + k2^2 + k3^2 + k8^2) (8 each); [B, h] = 0 (also with the curved term 3 i H gamma^(4) gamma^(x8) of gamma^mu Omega_mu), so the B = +1 and B = -1 eigenspaces (8-dim each) are invariant, each with energies +-E (exact example m = 2, k = (1,2,0,k8=4) on B = +1: +5 (x4), -5 (x4)); extra-time momenta mix the two sectors (B anticommutes with gamma^(4) gamma^(x5,x6,x7)). With Psi^dagger realised as the adjoint the B = -1 sector carries negative Krein norm; the positive realisation follows in the next check

checks.name: good_sector_positive_fock_realisation
checks.section: H. canonical quantisation in 4+4 (dirac16complex)
checks.detail: good sector, exact example m = 2, k = (1,2,0,k8=4), E = 5: with orthonormal eigenvectors u_s (E = +5), v_s (E = -5) of the Hermitian h and Psi = sum_s (u_s b_s + v_s d_s^*), {b, b^*} = {d, d^*} = 1 on a POSITIVE Fock space, the field conjugate is realised as Psi^dagger = chi B with chi the Hilbert adjoint (so {Psi_A, Psi^dagger_C} = (U U^* B)_AC = B_AC, the canonical relation); exact CAR evaluation: normal-ordered energy chi h Psi = +5 for b_0^*|0> and +5 for d_0^*|0> (vacuum value -40 = -8E, the filled sea), charge chi Psi = +1 and -1; expectation-value rule <:Psi^dagger M Psi:> = u^dagger B M u for particles and -v^dagger B M v for antiparticles, for a generic symbolic 16x16 M (exact)

checks.name: extra_time_modes_grow
checks.section: H. canonical quantisation in 4+4 (dirac16complex)
checks.detail: with extra-time momentum E^2 = m^2 + k_space^2 - k_t^2 < 0 when k_t^2 > m^2 + k_space^2: exact example m = 1, k5 = 2: eigenvalues ['-sqrt(3)*I', 'sqrt(3)*I'], i.e. modes ~ e^{sqrt(3) x4} grow; in the metric the frame momentum k_(x5) = e^{a4} sin(z)^{-1/6} k_x5 (coordinate k_x5) grows as the extra times deflate (a4 increasing), so every extra-time mode eventually enters the growing regime (local frame / WKB statement)

checks.name: expectation_value_rule
checks.section: H. canonical quantisation in 4+4 (dirac16complex)
checks.detail: with B-orthonormal modes u_n (u_n^dagger B u_m = eps_n delta_nm, including a Krein-boosted pair) and Psi = sum_n u_n b_n, {b_n, b_m^dagger} = eps_n delta_nm: {Psi, Psi^dagger} = sum eps_n u_n u_n^dagger = B, and in the one-particle state b_n^dagger|0> (norm eps_n) the normalised expectation of the normal-ordered :Psi^dagger M Psi: equals eps_n u_n^dagger M u_n for a generic symbolic M (exact Fock evaluation); for an observable written Psibar-form Psi^dagger C N Psi = -i Psi^dagger B gamma^(4) N ... the same rule applies with M = C N; positive-norm modes (eps = +1) give u^dagger M u.  For modes that are B-eigenvectors (B u = eps u) this equals u^dagger B M u (the SPEC section 6 form), verified exactly; for a Krein-boosted mode the form u^dagger B M u does NOT hold (verified), so the general rule is eps_n u_n^dagger M u_n

checks.name: hamiltonian_form_and_heisenberg_equation
checks.section: I. Hamiltonian form, energy exchange, exact solutions
checks.detail: with Hd = sqrt|g| [Psi^dagger (m C - sum_(mu != x4) C gamma^mu D_mu) Psi + U(S)] the unsymmetrised L = sqrt|g| Psibar gamma^(x4) d4 Psi - Hd exactly (Omega_x4 = 0), and d4 Psi_A = -i B_AC (1/sqrt|g|) dHd/dPsi^dagger_C (the Heisenberg equation for {Psi, Psi^dagger} = B/sqrt|g|) equals the field equation solved for d4 Psi, -gamma^(x4)[(m + lambda S) Psi - sum_(mu != x4) gamma^mu D_mu Psi], exactly (lambda general; operator ordering of the classical expression)

checks.name: energy_exchange_equation
checks.section: I. Hamiltonian form, energy exchange, exact solutions
checks.detail: for a diagonal T^mu_nu = diag(p3,p3,p3,-rho,p_t,p_t,p_t,p8)(x4): nabla_mu T^mu_x4 = -3*A1*p3 + 3*A1*pt - rho_1 (rho_1 = d rho/dx4), so conservation gives d rho/dx4 = -3 a4' (p3 - p_t): energy flows between 3-space and the extra times unless p3 = p_t; nabla_mu T^mu_x8 = 3*H*cot(6*H*x8)*(2*p8 - p3 - p_t) exactly, so a conserved x8-independent diagonal T needs p8 = (p3 + p_t)/2; the other components vanish identically

checks.name: exact_solution_family_x4_x8
checks.section: I. Hamiltonian form, energy exchange, exact solutions
checks.detail: Psi = sin(z)^alpha (cosh(k x4) + sinh(k x4)/k M) chi, M = -m gamma^(x4) + 3 H (2 alpha + 1) gamma^(x4) gamma^(x8), k^2 = 9 H^2 (2 alpha + 1)^2 - m^2, constant chi (16 components), solves gamma^mu D_mu Psi = m Psi exactly for every a4(x4) and every alpha (M^2 = k^2 I16, M^T C + C M = 0 so S is x4-independent); a test of the Tan(z) gamma^(x8) d8 and 3 H gamma^(x8) terms (independent re-derivation of the Wolfram side's exact solutions; linear in chi, so it holds for either statistics at U = 0)

checks.name: exact_nonlinear_homogeneous_solution
checks.section: I. Hamiltonian form, energy exchange, exact solutions
checks.detail: Phi = (cosh(k x4) + sinh(k x4)/k M) chi, M = -(m + lambda S0) gamma^(x4) + 3 H gamma^(x4) gamma^(x8), k^2 = 9 H^2 - (m + lambda S0)^2: exp(M^T x4) C exp(M x4) = C so S = chi^dagger C chi = S0 is constant, and gamma^mu D_mu Phi = (m + lambda S0) Phi = (m + U'(S)) Phi exactly: an exact homogeneous solution of the nonlinear commuting field dirac16complex00 (U = (lambda/2) S^2); its EMT is the homogeneous on-shell form rho = m S0 + U, p = S0 U' - U (check *_homogeneous_on_shell_rho_p)

formulas.ring_notation: E = exp(a4(x4)), s = sin(6 H x8)^(1/6), c = cos(6 H x8), A1 = a4', A2 = a4''; physical forms substitute these

dirac_equation_components.statement: E_A = (gamma^mu D_mu Psi - (m + lambda S) Psi)_A = 0, A = 1..16; psiA_xk = d psi_A / d xk; chi = Psi^dagger; the same 16 equations for both statistics

T_x4_x8_homogeneous_on_shell.statement: T^x4_x8 for states depending on x4 only, on shell (bilinear coefficients by monomial)

quantisation.momentum: pi_A = i sqrt|g| (Psi^dagger B)_A (first-order form), B = -i C gamma^(x4)
quantisation.anticommutator: {Psi_A(x), Psi^dagger_B(y)} = B_AB delta^7(x - y)/sqrt|g| on x4 = const
quantisation.krein: B Hermitian, B^2 = 1, signature (8,8): indefinite (Krein) state space
quantisation.good_sector: k5 = k6 = k7 = 0: [B, h] = 0; B = +1 sector positive (Dirac-like Fock space), B = -1 sector negative norm
quantisation.expectation_rule: <n| :Psi^dagger M Psi: |n>/<n|n> = eps_n u_n^dagger M u_n, u_n^dagger B u_n = eps_n; = u_n^dagger B M u_n when B u_n = eps_n u_n
quantisation.emt_operator: T^mu_nu = :-Theta^mu_nu + delta^mu_nu (K - V):, normal ordered with respect to the modes; one-particle expectation = eps_n times the classical bilinear evaluated on u_n

energy_exchange.T: diag(p3, p3, p3, -rho, p_t, p_t, p_t, p8), functions of x4 only

formulas.lagrangian: L = sqrt|g| [ (1/2)(Psibar gamma^mu D_mu Psi - (D_mu Psibar) gamma^mu Psi) - m Psibar Psi - (lambda/2) (Psibar Psi)^2 ], Psibar = Psi^dagger C, gamma^mu = e^mu_a gamma^a, D_mu Psi = d_mu Psi + Omega_mu Psi
formulas.euler_lagrange: gamma^mu D_mu Psi = (m + lambda S) Psi;  D_mu Psibar gamma^mu = -(m + lambda S) Psibar; in this metric: e^{-a4} sin(z)^(-1/6) gamma^(xi) d_i Psi (i=1,2,3) + gamma^(x4) d_4 Psi + e^{a4} sin(z)^(-1/6) gamma^(xj) d_j Psi (j=5,6,7) + tan(z) gamma^(x8) d_8 Psi + 3 H gamma^(x8) Psi = (m + lambda S) Psi, z = 6 H x8
formulas.current: J^mu = -i Psibar gamma^mu Psi (real); nabla_mu J^mu = 0 on shell

emt.Theta: Theta^mu_nu = (1/4)[Psibar gamma^mu D_nu Psi - D_nu Psibar gamma^mu Psi + g^{mu mu} g_{nu nu} (Psibar gamma^nu D_mu Psi - D_mu Psibar gamma^nu Psi)]
emt.K: K = (1/2)(Psibar gamma^mu D_mu Psi - D_mu Psibar gamma^mu Psi)
emt.V: V = m S + U, U = (lambda/2) S^2
emt.T: T^mu_nu = -Theta^mu_nu + delta^mu_nu (K - V);  T_kin = -Theta + delta K;  T_pot = -delta V
emt.trace: T^mu_mu = 7K - 8V; on shell -m S + 7 S U' - 8 U = -m S + 3 lambda S^2
emt.homogeneous_on_shell: rho = m S + U, p3 = p_t = p8 = S U' - U, w = (S U' - U)/(m S + U) = lambda S/(2m + lambda S)
emt.Theta_diag_in_metric: Theta^xi_xi = (1/2) f_i^{-1} (Psibar gamma^(xi) d_i Psi - d_i Psibar gamma^(xi) Psi) (no sum; the Omega terms cancel since {gamma^(xi), Omega_(xi)} = 0), f = (e^a4 s, e^a4 s, e^a4 s, 1, e^-a4 s, e^-a4 s, e^-a4 s, cot z), s = sin(z)^(1/6)

records.detail: each statement of the Wolfram quantisation summary is present and has a passing sympy counterpart: 'pi_A = (i/2) Cos[z] (Psi^dagger B)_A' <-> canonical_momentum; '{Psi_A(x), Psi^dagger_C(y)}_(x4 = y4) = B_AC delta^7(x - y)/Cos[z]' <-> canonical_anticommutator_B; 'signature (8,8)' <-> B_properties; 'no positive inner product' <-> no_positive_inner_product; 'positive representation chi = Psi^dagger B' <-> good_sector_positive_fock_realisation; 'h Hermitian' <-> good_sector_spectrum_and_B_sectors; '<Psi^dagger M Psi> = u^dagger B M u' <-> good_sector_positive_fock_realisation; 'E^2 = m^2 + k_s^2 - k_t^2' <-> mode_hamiltonian_B_selfadjoint_dispersion. Convention note: the sympy side states the rule in two realisations - (i) Psi^dagger the adjoint in a Krein-Fock space: <:Psi^dagger M Psi:> = eps u^dagger M u (= u^dagger B M u for B-eigenvector modes); (ii) the positive Fock space with Psi^dagger = chi B: u^dagger B M u for particles, -v^dagger B M v for antiparticles (the Wolfram form)
